phrases.text: Meet Domios. A home for your AI agents.
Open a tab, choose an agent, and get to work.
Give your next task its own team.
Then follow the work across the board, through to a result.
Your own computers, connected in one trusted mesh.
Reach a workspace on another machine.
Ask an agent to check in with its peers.
And bring their reports back here.
Choose the intelligence that fits your work.
See your fleet, including who is offline.
Every agent on this machine shares one memory. Facts, decisions, and skills stay with Domios, so the next agent can pick up where you left off.
Your next idea. A whole team behind it. Domios.
